short_description: An e-bike maker's warranty claims jumped a third, hidden behind generic dealer labor codes. AI Functions classify every technician note, an early-warning board flags a supplier-lot failure, and the Warranty Copilot app (Databricks App on Lakebase) assembles the root-cause case with live lakehouse SQL and the Genie agent over PPAPs, PCNs and the supplier agreement, prices containment, drafts the 8D + chargeback and writes the quality case back; the VP Quality tracks claims per 1,000 bikes, cost per bike and supplier recovery in an AI/BI dashboard and Genie.
